description: The family preset, as every package repository uses it (read from main; renovate-config.yml validates it on every pull request).

github-actions.description: The workflow templates end in .template, outside the default file patterns; their action pins stay current here.

packageRules.description: In the templates the assertions-ci pin is the {{assertions-ci}} placeholder that family_sync.py fills in: never pin or update it.
Renovate releases several times a day; its image (the config validator) moves once a week.
